question: The Digambara sect belongs to which of the following religions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jainism**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Digambara sect is one of the two main sects in Jainism.
 
• Digambara means "sky-clad" and its monks traditionally do not wear any clothes, symbolizing their renunciation of worldly possessions.
 
• This sect believes that women must be reborn as men to achieve liberation.
 
• The other main sect in Jainism is the Sve
